mapper.delete: delete from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
delete from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select 100-sum(nvl(PRIN_AMT,0)) from FIN_CASH_PLAN where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and MDATE <= to_date(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by FINPROD_ID
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM (SELECT * FROM MST_BOND_MARK_INFO_FULL WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM =1

SELECT EXERCISE_PRICE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE = ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '02' AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '01'} and rownum = 1

SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND V.TRADE_PLACE = '01' AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
